name: Lab artifacts: Claude Code headless, whether its Artifact tool is offered, and what it makes from Oby's guide (informational, never red)
description: LAB-ARTIFACTS-20 (src/lab/artifacts.rs: claude_headless; lab-ui/artifacts/scripts/claude-headless.mjs; lab-ui/artifacts/guide.md). The owner's own Claude Code, on its own login as Oby's own lane runs it, headless in stream-json: its system/init says whether Claude's Artifact tool is offered, with and without --allowedTools Artifact (the bridge to Claude waits for it). Then it makes a design from Oby's guide alone, with Read, Write and Edit only, and its time, turns, tokens and cost are kept; Oby's own runtime then draws it (oby_artifact_check) and says each board's mistake. Nothing here can go red: the steps record what was offered and made. Without Claude Code on the computer, and no run to replay (OBID_SPEC_LAB_CLAUDE_HEADLESS_FROM), it is skipped.
